summary: Just before the Artemis II crew began its historic slingshot around the moon this past April, NASA announced plans to build Space Reactor-1 Freedom. summary: We all know exercise is good for us. It builds muscle, strengthens bones, lowers blood pressure, and boosts mood. summary: Scrubbing Earth of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances—a.k.a. PFAS or forever chemicals—could eliminate a list of woes for people and planet.
